current_ihs_facility_observation: Current IHS Tucson Area page lists Sells Indian Hospital under Tribally Operated Healthcare Facilities - Sells Service Unit and gives P.O. Box 548, Highway 86, Sells AZ 85634.
current_ihs_program_observation: Current IHS Tucson Area material states that the Tohono O'odham Nation Healthcare Sells Service Unit operates a 14-bed hospital through a tribal Self-Determination PL 93-638 Title V compact.
compact_observation: IHS states the compact and funding agreement became effective July 1, 2016 and transferred administrative and clinical operations of the Sells Service Unit, with associated funding, to the Tohono O'odham Nation.
interpretation: The exact CMS CCN/name/site and Tribal ownership agree with current first-party IHS Sells Service Unit identity. Current IHS information confirms operation under an IHS-funded PL 93-638 Title V compact. 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2), read with 25 USC 1603(12) and (25), supports this Indian Health Program scope classification; it is not an MRF availability or file-quality finding.
next_action: Retain the current IHS compact/program and facility identity sources; revisit if the operator, compact or CCN changes.
